packages.description: Shared foundational package containing cross-cutting skills used across product, engineering, operations, and support tracks.
Authoring package containing specialist agents and skills for writing high-quality OpenCode skills and sub-agents.
Core Triad package containing the Product Manager, Lead Engineer, Lead UX/UI Designer, and foundational triad skills.
Execution and Operations package containing delivery, architecture, QA, and workflow orchestration agents with supporting skills.
Specialized support package containing DevOps and Security agents for infrastructure, observability, threat modeling, and compliance auditing.
Git Writing package containing PR and release notes writers for reviewer-ready and release-ready change communication.
